source: Lutellier et al., "Comparing Software Architecture Recovery Techniques Using Accurate Dependencies", ICSE 2015 (extended: TSE 2018, doi:10.1109/TSE.2017.2671865). Ground truth extracted by ITK developers after the 2013 modularization refactoring.
retrieved_via: Wayback Machine snapshot 2019-05-21 (https://web.archive.org/web/20190521095552id_/http://asset.uwaterloo.ca/ArchRecovery/gt/itk_gt.rsf); original host no longer resolves (checked 2026-06-12)
format: RSF `contain <cluster> <repo-relative-file-path>` tuples, verbatim from the published dataset (no edits)
notes: Paper's Table reports 7,310 files / 11 clusters for ITK 4.5.2; the published RSF as archived contains 7,657 entities in 13 clusters (the paper likely excludes small/auxiliary groups from its summary table). We score against the published file verbatim. Entities are repo-relative paths matching `arch export --graph --granularity file` naming.
